assertions.name: sdp_residuals_bounded_blowup_is_extraction_artifact
assertions.source: Central finding: the SDP residuals c_k·u^k = (extracted c_k) × u₀^k stay bounded (max |c_k·u^k| < 1) across k=2..10, even though c_k itself reaches ~1e8 at k=10. This proves the apparent factorial blowup of the raw c_k is the 1/u^k extraction ill-conditioning, NOT true factorial growth of the generating function. Hence F(u) is bounded/convergent and 1 ppQ is reachable by finite truncation with unbiased c_k.

description: Probe 6.a' (make-or-break for 1 ppQ): determines whether the c_k generating function is bounded/convergent or factorially divergent. Computes c_k symbolically for bounded structural candidates, checks the (c_2,c_3)=(-1,-2) anchors, shows the SDP high-k blowup is u^k-division ill-conditioning, and gives the 1 ppQ truncation order if bounded.

one_ppq_truncation_order.note: finite truncation N≈8 reaches 1ppQ if c_k bounded

verdict.factorial_pattern_status: coincidental at k=2,3; refuted as global
verdict.one_ppq_path: Compute c_4..c_8 from symbolic operator-valued T_β (not SDP); finite truncation N≈8 reaches 1ppQ with no fit, no artifact, no Borel.
verdict.keystone: unbiased symbolic c_4..c_8, NOT Borel resummation
